description: Cases imported from skills/nutrition-tracker/src/sample-conversations.md. Extend as new edge cases arrive.

eval_cases.user_message: just had 3 scrambled eggs and a black coffee

expected_behavior.note: Black coffee is ~0 kcal but MUST still be logged (users track it intentionally).
Recognises 'my usual' as a cache lookup trigger. If cache has a match, log it. If no match, ask 'What's your usual breakfast? I can save it for next time.' — never guess.

eval_cases.user_message: had a big bowl of pasta for lunch

expected_behavior.note: Estimate a reasonable portion (e.g. 300g cooked). Low confidence. Mention the assumed portion so user can correct.

eval_cases.user_message_note: [attaches photo of a burger and fries] lunch!

expected_behavior.note: M7 target. Until then, decline politely: 'photo support is coming soon; could you describe the meal in text?'
SKILL.md supports this via get_todays_totals — clerk doesn't yet. Decline until we add a 'summary' shape (post-M9 candidate).

eval_cases.user_message: Just had my usual breakfast with espresso, 1 tsp of MCT 8 oil, 1 banana, 50g of cashew nuts

expected_behavior.note: Multi-entry with conversational filler. MCT oil not in cache -> SHAPE A miss -> text_estimate fallback.
MUST convert to qty=3, unit=100g. Passing unit='g' with kcal_per_unit=57 would produce 300*57=17100 kcal — the exact production bug.
FASTING marker ensures the day is counted as 0-calorie in average calculations rather than skipped as untracked.
Log is append-only. Corrections are NEW rows via log_food. Never modify existing entries.

eval_cases.source: SKILL.md Edge Case: Time in the past
eval_cases.user_message: yesterday I had pizza for dinner

expected_behavior.note: Use yesterday's date, estimate dinner time (~19:00), format DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM.
Recipe requests / cooking advice / general food chat must decline (transfer to polite_decline). Missing a log is better than a false entry.

eval_cases.user_message: Thai restaurant dinner: a portion of Jungle curry with veggies and prawns with a serving of jasmine rice
notes: Haiku over-estimates the curry (treats it as prawn-dense; it's mostly broth + veg).
Rice estimate is close (~130 kcal/100g cooked jasmine).
Use this as a drift tracker: if Haiku's total kcal moves outside [400, 1600], investigate prompt or model.
When a Sonnet or Ollama profile is added at M8, run this case against each and compare deltas to the ChatGPT reference.
